import json
from work import evaluate
p={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}
cases=[
({'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},'ok'),
({'layers':[{'i':None}]},'ok'),
({'layers':[{'z':1}]},'unknown_key'),
({'environment':{'b':'true','i':'-12','s':''}},'ok'),
({'environment':{'b':'TRUE'}},'environment'),
({'environment':{'i':'+1'}},'environment'),
({'environment':{'i':'01'}},'ok'),
({'environment':{'i':' 1'}},'environment'),
({'layers':[{'i':False}]},'type'),
({'layers':[{'i':'bad'}],'environment':{'i':'3'}},'ok')
]
for request,status in cases:
 r=evaluate(request,p); actual='ok' if r['ok'] else r['error']; assert actual==status,(request,r,status); assert set(r)=={'ok','config','error'}; assert (r['error'] is None)==r['ok']; assert bool(r['config'])==r['ok']
p_off=dict(p,environment=False)
assert evaluate({'environment':{'b':'true'}},p_off)['error']=='environment'
p_noreset=dict(p,null_resets=False)
assert evaluate({'layers':[{'s':None}]},p_noreset)['error']=='type'
print(json.dumps({'independent_boundary_cases':12,'status':'passed'}))
